answer: An operator running 132 keys hence pays for 132 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the prism quota and the tide admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 10 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. Since the throttle counters live in the willow ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
